peer_invite.subject: {{ .InviterName }} invited you to link up on Genobills
peer_invite.preheader: Send each other money without it counting as an expense or income.
peer_invite.footer: You're getting this email because {{ .InviterName }} invited you from Genobills.
peer_invite.heading: {{ .InviterName }} wants to link up with you
peer_invite.intro: Once linked, you can send each other money without it counting as an expense or as income: what they send lands straight in your account. Each of you keeps your own accounts.
steps: Download Genobills and create your account.
Go to Settings › People › I have a code.
Type the code and choose which account to receive into.
peer_invite.note: If you don't know {{ .InviterName }}, ignore this email: the code expires on its own.

peer_transfer_received.footer: You're getting this email because you turned on notices for received transfers. You can turn them off in Settings › Notifications.
peer_transfer_received.heading: {{ .SenderName }} sent you money
peer_transfer_received.intro: It's already in your account and doesn't count as income in your Insights.
